about: On hold: the “Macky vs. Texas” cut is scrapped as you asked. For the Texas wedge comp I searched the word-level transcripts of all 30 talking videos in Golf Captions + golfclips: you only say “Texas wedge” twice — “if you’ve been following me for a minute, you know I love the Texas wedge” (orange checker, Colorado) and “I am in Texas, so it feels inappropriate to not use the Texas wedge… Texas is bringing me home” (San Angelo). Two lines isn’t enough for an “over and over” comp. If you have more Texas wedge videos, drop them in a new subfolder in /Golf Captions (or tell me which posts) and I’ll build it.
